about: Shared vectors for the wire format in docs/engine/WIRE.md. Engine/Tests/RowsTests/WireTests.swift and the Worker's tests check every case. Times are milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, and days are Day indexes, the days since 1970-01-01.

stamps.name: the next write in the same millisecond

days.name: New York, the last millisecond of a day
New York, the word's run at 06:00
New York, just before clocks spring forward
New York, 03:00 right after they spring forward
New York, the end of the 23-hour day
New York, midnight after the 23-hour day
New York, the first 01:30 of the day clocks fall back
New York, the end of the 25-hour day
Kolkata, half an hour off UTC, before midnight
Sydney in summer time, before midnight

keys.name: the word's key, minted when its task was made

changes.name: insertRow: the word of the day, written ahead
setCell: text at the limit, 300 UTF-16 units with an emoji counted as 2
setCell: text over the limit decodes, and receive refuses it
insertRow: the earliest day and at
insertRow: the latest day and at

badChanges.name: the stamp with a leading zero
a row key that is a UUIDv4
a dataset that is not a UUID
a replica that is not a UUID
a day as an ISO date
a text kind with a number value
a number kind with a string value
a date kind with an ISO date
a date kind with a fraction

badPages.name: one change that does not decode refuses the whole page
a replica that is not a UUID
an entry with an unknown key

receive.name: an empty page records the automation replica
a held change stops the page and its watermark
text over the limit is refused and the watermark passes it
a tombstone wins in either order
the larger stamp wins, then the larger replica
